# What does the EU Pay Transparency Directive require of your company?

> Free EU Pay Transparency Directive checker for employers: which duties apply at your headcount, which are still open, and which job categories hit the 5% pay gap trigger. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
